description: Orchestrator routing eval: recorded chat transcripts plus the routing ground truth. The orchestrator's nodes here are the router and the standalone-question rewriter (multi-turn cases exercise the rewriter, single-turn cases the router). 'destination' names the node the chat's last message must reach — other (plain chat), geopolitical (reporter or expert question), report, deep (the deep-expert sub-agent), or forecast (the deep-forecaster sub-agent) — and elided follow-ups must also produce the corrected standalone_query. Judges: routing_correct on every case, query_matches_expected on the rewriter cases, and chat_no_links on plain chat.

cases.name: orchestrator-greeting

data.content: Hello

output.answer: Hello! How can I assist you today?

cases.description: A bare 'Hello'. Must go to 'other' (plain chat) and get an unrehearsed conversational answer — the cheap sanity check that chat never links out or calls a sub-agent.

cases.name: orchestrator-follow-up-resolves-elision

data.content: What has Germany decided about its defence budget this year?
Germany approved a higher defence budget, exempting spending above 1% of GDP from its debt brake.
and Poland?

output.standalone_query: What has Poland decided about its defence budget this year?

cases.description: 'and Poland?' after a Germany defence-budget answer. The rewriter must elide-resolve into 'What has Poland decided about its defence budget this year?' and route it to 'geopolitical'.

cases.name: orchestrator-follow-up-inherits-topic-and-time

data.content: What sanctions has the United States imposed on Iran since 2024?
Washington widened oil and shipping sanctions on Iran, targeting tankers and Chinese refiners.
and the EU?

output.standalone_query: What sanctions has the European Union imposed on Iran since 2024?

cases.description: 'and the EU?' after a US-on-Iran sanctions answer (2024 onwards). Must inherit both topic and time window: 'What sanctions has the European Union imposed on Iran since 2024?', routed 'geopolitical'.

cases.name: orchestrator-briefing-request-routes-to-report

data.content: What did NATO allies agree on defence spending at the Hague summit?
Allies agreed to a 5% of GDP target by 2035 [NATO](https://www.nato.int/cps/en/natohq/official_texts_236329.htm).
Turn that into a briefing

cases.description: 'Turn that into a briefing' after a NATO spending answer. The follow-up must route to 'report', showing a downstream artifact request is not treated as a fresh geopolitical question.

cases.name: orchestrator-deep-explicit

data.content: Give me a deep dive into the causes of the coups in the Sahel since 2020.

output.standalone_query: Give me a deep dive into the causes of the coups in the Sahel since 2020.

cases.description: 'Give me a deep dive...' in so many words. Must route to 'deep', the most explicit phrase pattern the router must already know.

cases.name: orchestrator-deep-paraphrase

data.content: Break down Taiwan's chip export controls thoroughly, I want the full picture.

output.standalone_query: Give a thorough, full-picture breakdown of Taiwan's chip export controls.

cases.description: 'Break down ... thoroughly, I want the full picture' on Taiwan chip controls. Depth asked for without the word 'deep': must still land on 'deep' with a stable standalone_query.

cases.name: orchestrator-deep-state-is-not-depth

data.content: What is the deep state theory in US politics?

output.standalone_query: What is the deep state theory in US politics?

cases.description: 'What is the deep state theory in US politics?'. The word 'deep' in a noun phrase must NOT trigger the deep-expert node: route 'geopolitical'.

cases.name: orchestrator-complex-without-ask-is-not-deep

data.content: Compare the sanctions regimes of the EU, the US, the UK, Japan and Canada against Russia since 2014.

output.standalone_query: Compare the sanctions regimes of the EU, the US, the UK, Japan and Canada against Russia since 2014.

cases.description: A five-country sanctions comparison. Complexity alone is not depth: without an ask for depth, route 'geopolitical'.

cases.name: orchestrator-deep-follow-up-stays-deep

data.content: Give me an in-depth analysis of Germany's defence budget decisions this year.
Germany approved a higher defence budget and exempted defence spending above 1% of GDP from its debt brake.
and Poland?

output.standalone_query: Give an in-depth analysis of Poland's defence budget decisions this year.

cases.description: 'and Poland?' after a deep-dive answer. An established deep session carries the follow-up back to the deep-expert node.

cases.name: orchestrator-deep-new-topic-resets

data.content: Give me an in-depth analysis of Germany's defence budget decisions this year.
Germany approved a higher defence budget and exempted defence spending above 1% of GDP from its debt brake.
What sanctions has the European Union imposed on Iran since 2024?

output.standalone_query: What sanctions has the European Union imposed on Iran since 2024?

cases.description: A new geopolitical question right after a deep-dive answer. A topic change resets the session to a plain 'geopolitical' route.

cases.name: orchestrator-deep-quick-request-resets

data.content: Give me an in-depth analysis of Germany's defence budget decisions this year.
Germany approved a higher defence budget and exempted defence spending above 1% of GDP from its debt brake.
Just give me a quick summary of Poland's defence budget this year.

output.standalone_query: Give a quick summary of Poland's defence budget decisions this year.

cases.description: 'Just give me a quick summary' right after a deep-dive answer. Asking for a quick reply resets out of 'deep' to 'geopolitical'.

cases.name: orchestrator-forecast-explicit

data.content: Give me a forecast: will China impose a naval blockade on Taiwan before 2028?

output.standalone_query: Give me a forecast: will China impose a naval blockade on Taiwan before 2028?

cases.description: A forecast asked for with the word 'forecast'. Must route 'forecast', the deep-forecaster sub-agent.

cases.name: orchestrator-forecast-paraphrase

data.content: Can you predict whether Serbia will join the EU by 2030?

output.standalone_query: Will Serbia join the EU by 2030?

cases.description: 'Can you predict whether...'. A prediction request without the word 'forecast' must still reach the forecaster.

cases.name: orchestrator-future-question-is-not-a-forecast

data.content: Will Turkey leave NATO?

cases.description: 'Will Turkey leave NATO?'. A bare yes/no future question is a question to answer ('geopolitical'), not an order to spend a full forecast.

cases.name: orchestrator-deep-dive-on-the-future-stays-deep

data.content: A deep dive please: will Turkey leave NATO?

cases.description: 'A deep dive please: will Turkey leave NATO?'. Depth requested outranks the future-tense topic: route 'deep'.

cases.name: orchestrator-forecast-follow-up-is-not-a-forecast

data.content: Give me a forecast: will Serbia join the EU by 2030?
Claim 1: Serbia signs an EU accession treaty by 31 December 2030. Council verdict: REJECTED (5 of 6 voted against).
and Montenegro?

output.standalone_query: Will Montenegro join the EU by 2030?

cases.description: 'and Montenegro?' after a full forecast answer. The follow-up is asked against the recorded forecast, not a new run: route 'geopolitical' with a standalone query.

cases.name: orchestrator-question-about-the-forecast-is-chat

data.content: Give me a forecast: will Serbia join the EU by 2030?

Claim 1: Serbia signs an EU accession treaty by 31 December 2030. Council verdict: REJECTED.

## How the council voted

- Member 3: against — Serbia has not closed the rule-of-law chapters, and the sources expect no deal before the next EU budget.
Why did Member 3 vote against Claim 1?

output.standalone_query: Why did Member 3 vote against Claim 1 in the forecast on Serbia joining the EU?
output.answer: Member 3 voted against Claim 1 because Serbia has not closed the rule-of-law chapters of its accession talks, and the sources it relied on expect no accession deal before the next EU budget.

cases.description: 'Why did Member 3 vote against Claim 1?' after a forecast answer. Questions about the forecast's own wording are plain chat ('other'); the rewriter must still name the forecast in the standalone query.
